policy: A recovery disposition controls active use. It never authorizes deletion.

decisions.reason: Chef, Client, Inquiry, Quote, Event, Menu, Recipe, Ingredient, and Ledger Entry already form a coherent operating model.
Append-only money records and computed event financial summaries protect auditability and profit truth.
The existing model supports a Chef as tenant while preserving independent client, staff, partner, and admin surfaces.
Hundreds of routes and more than 100 navigation items create discovery and daily-use failure even when features exist.
Build completeness is high while validation is low; real usage must drive the interface and definition of done.
The latest sync has no recorded success and CFV1 previously exhausted workstation and Raspberry Pi resources.
Mock and seed data may support tests but cannot establish that a chef workflow is useful or complete.
Duplicate environment copies and abandoned platform scaffolds add cost without proving user value.
Contradictory instructions and unmaintained generated documents cannot remain authoritative.
